# ractermx_alert_rule (Resource)

Manages a RacterMX alert rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create an alert rule that triggers when the security posture score drops below B.
resource "ractermx_alert_rule" "security_alert" {
  domain_id       = ractermx_domain.example.id
  name            = "Security Score Alert"
  alert_type      = "security_posture"
  condition       = "below"
  threshold_value = "B"
  cooldown_minutes = 120

  channels {
    channel_type = "email"
    email_address = "ops@example.com"
  }
}

# Create an alert rule for blacklist changes with a webhook notification.
resource "ractermx_alert_rule" "blacklist_alert" {
  domain_id  = ractermx_domain.example.id
  name       = "Blacklist Change Alert"
  alert_type = "blacklist_change"
  condition  = "any_change"

  channels {
    channel_type        = "webhook"
    webhook_endpoint_id = ractermx_webhook.events.id
  }
}

resource "ractermx_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

resource "ractermx_webhook" "events" {
  url    = "https://hooks.example.com/ractermx"
  events = ["delivered", "bounced"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alert_type` (String) The type of alert (deliverability_score, blacklist_change, security_posture, dmarc_compliance).
- `channels` (Attributes List) Notification channels for this alert rule (1-3 items). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))
- `condition` (String) The condition for the alert (below, above, equals, any_change).
- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain this alert rule applies to.
- `name` (String) The name of the alert rule (1-100 chars).

### Optional

- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Cooldown period in minutes between alerts (15-1440, default 60).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alert rule is enabled.
- `threshold_value` (String) The threshold value for the alert (max 50 chars). Required for some alert types.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the alert rule was created.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the alert rule.

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Required:

- `channel_type` (String) The type of channel (webhook or email).

Optional:

- `email_address` (String) The email address (required when channel_type is email).
- `webhook_endpoint_id` (Number) The webhook endpoint ID (required when channel_type is webhook).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an alert rule using its numeric ID.
terraform import ractermx_alert_rule.security_alert 99
```
